# Support

> 🌐 Language / Ngôn ngữ: **English** | [Tiếng Việt](https://github.com/dangkhoa2016/Tencent-WeMM-Embedding-9B-Kaggle-T4x2-GPU/blob/main/.github/SUPPORT.vi.md)

This is an open-source engineering project with best-effort community support. It does not provide an SLA, managed hosting, HA, or multi-tenant production support.

Use GitHub Issues for reproducible source bugs, Kaggle setup problems, API contract issues, documentation defects, and focused enhancement proposals. Remove credentials, tokens, private data, and private paths before posting.
